chunks: Then the man stands and swears four times by Allah.
Indeed, he is surely among the truthful.
Concerning what he accused her of. Then the Imam says to him: Fear Allah, for the curse of Allah is severe. Then the man says: The curse of Allah be upon him.
If he is among the liars.
Concerning what he accused her of. Then the woman stands and swears four times by Allah.
Indeed, he is surely among the liars.
Concerning what he accused her of. Then the Imam says to her: Fear Allah, for the anger of Allah is severe. Then the woman says: The anger of Allah be upon her.
If he is among the truthful.
Concerning what he accused her of.

key_terms.الرَّجُلُ: the husband or man initiating the oath process
key_terms.الصَّادِقِينَ: those who are truthful in the claim being made
key_terms.الْإِمَامُ: the Imam who oversees and directs the li'an procedure
key_terms.الْكَاذِبِينَ: those who are lying in the accusation
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the wife or woman responding with counter-oaths
key_terms.رَمَاهَا: he accused her; the allegation at issue in li'an
key_terms.غَضَبَ اللَّهِ: Allah's anger invoked in the final oath
key_terms.لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ: Allah's curse invoked upon oneself if lying

ai.seo_question: How is the procedure of li'an performed in a Shia hadith narration?
ai.summary: This report describes the procedure of li'an, in which a husband and wife invoke solemn oaths before the Imam when an accusation is made between them. It emphasizes the gravity of truthful testimony, the severe consequence of false swearing, and the legal seriousness of invoking Allah's curse or anger in marital dispute.
